provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Astraevos is centered at 24.310043, 55.171453 under Noocracy, with 65,511,000 people across 9 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Astraevos occupies 9,434,750.70 sq mi / 24,435,892.13 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 4.790733% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water and Partial forest define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Beach and grass with water, Partial forest, Beach and reefs with water and Farming. Population density is 2.681 people/sq km / 6.944 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Draconic and Reptilian Races, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Harengon, Elf — Wood Elf, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi, Hadozee, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Brass Concordat and The Regent Lattice, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Sigrananna, Iskareth, Raeshkul, Bastveig, Marduthor, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 7 recorded four-province geography group links, including 5 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Solomon Rootbottle
npcs.description: Solomon Rootbottle is an Umbral Human chemist whose clinic shelves are a dangerous mix of real medicine, folk tonics, diluted ichor, and things he insists are educational if measured carefully. He is one of the city's most functional ichor users: too lost in his own haze to be predatory, but far too casual about substances that ruin other people faster than they helped him. Solomon can heal, advise, and supply, but trusting his judgment requires knowing when his brilliance ends and his craving starts talking.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Aelmoryth is a Village in Astraevos, under Noocracy, with moderate danger, Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water terrain. Local records favor Neutral, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi. Umbral Human reads through the Human entry of the race compendium, within Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, marked by Nebyrr. The local form is read through Umbral Human. Humans are highly adaptable and found in nearly every environment across the world. They are known for their cultural diversity, short generational cycles, and unmatched versatility among mortal races. Table cues: Resourceful, Skillful, Versatile; starting tendency Neutral - Neutral - Neutral - Neutral.
rumors: Solomon can brew a painkiller that works miracles and a party drink that should be illegal by smell alone.
He calls black-market ichor 'research stock' whenever the watch is close enough to hear.
plotHooks: Solomon asks the party to retrieve a rare antidote component, but his notes reveal it may be for his own withdrawal.
Patients begin sharing the same vision after taking Solomon's legal tonic, and the source batch traces back to a god-prison leak.
